Commentary.Commentary: Now then 251 is the target! Not going to be an easy chase this for the Australians. The wicket is on the slower side and there is turn for the spinners. The visitors will have to bat really well here. Will India go 2-0 up or will the visitors level the series? Join us in a while to find out.

For Australia, Pat Cummins was the pick of the bowlers. He was given the responsibility of bowling with the new ball. Did well and then was also excellent at the death. Lyon was economical. Zampa was poor initially but pulled things back well in the end. Nathan Coulter-Nile though had a day to forget as he was wayward and expensive.

Zampa then got rid of Dhoni and Jadhav in the very same over. The Australia bowlers then managed to pull things back but India still had Kohli at one end. He went onto to score a brilliant ton. Jadeja played the perfect foil to him and the two added yet another handy stand. However, when the time came to accelerate, the latter perished. Kohli too followed him and then the tail failed to contribute much. From 238 for 6 in the 46th over, the hosts have been bundled out for 250.

A decent bowling effort from the Australian side. They will be happy with where they are at the moment but India too won't be very disappointed. However, they would feel they could have done better after Vijay Shankar and Virat Kohli's 81-run stand. They joined association after the Australians got rid of Rayudu, Dhawan and Rohit pretty quickly. The Indians were in a spot of bother at 75 for three but then Shankar and Kohli played themselves in. The former, once he got his eye in, started to accelerate. He looked really good out there and when he was batting, India looked well on course for 280. However, he fell in a very unfortunate manner and that changed the course of the game.
OUT!!! Bowled. Full length delivery around off, Bumrah looks to hit it on the off side but gets a thick inside edge and the ball hits the middle pole. Bumrah goes for a duck. INDIA ALL OUT FOR 250.
Shorter delivery on off, Shami pulls it away for a single.
Nathan Coulter-Nile back into the attack.
A dot to end! Just a run and two wickets from the 48th over. On the stumps, it is blocked.
Jasprit Bumrah walks out at number 11 for India.

OUT! TIMBER! Four-fer for Cummins! The slower one has done in Kuldeep completely. It is on the leg stump, Yadav shuffles way too across and tries to flick but is quite early into the stroke. He misses and the ball hits the stumps behind.
On the pads, the batter works it down to fine leg for a run.
On the slower side outside off, Shami plays it nicely with an angled bat but hits it too close to the keeper. He takes it on the bounce.
On a length and around off, Shami blocks it out.
Mohammed Shami replaces his skipper out in the middle.

OUT! Straight to the fielder! The best bowler for Australia today, gets the best batsman for India. Kohli can't believe it as he stands there, looks down and then turns and starts walking back. He returns dejected but to a standing ovation by the crowd here and he deserves it. Another brilliant innings from him. He falls prey to the short ball which he pulls nicely but does not get the desired distance. Stoinis at deep square leg takes a good sliding catch. Cummins gets his third and that too at the right time. Australia will now hope to keep India under 265.
Good running. Tossed up delivery on middle and leg, Yadav sweeps it wide of square leg and looks for two straight away. They get that easily as the throw is a poor one from the fielder.
Good shot but only a single. Flighted delivery on off, Kohli hits it through covers but there is a fielder in the deep.
Full on the leg side, Kuldeep sweeps it towards fine leg for a single.
Follows the boundary with a single. On middle and leg, Virat tucks it to the leg side for a single.
FOUR!!! Excellent shot. Tossed up delivery on middle and off, Kohli keeps his eyes on the ball and hits it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Shorter delivery on middle, Kohli taps it back to the bowler.
On the shorter side outside off, Kohli punches it through covers and takes a run.
Kuldeep Yadav is the new man in.

OUT! Jadeja perishes in the attempt to up the ante! However, he has played a good supporting role here. So the dropped catch has not cost a lot. Cummins bowls the slower one and on off. The idea of the shot was not wrong as Jadeja looked to go over mid off. He got it off the bottom though. It lobs towards mid off and Khawaja there takes it after taking a few steps back. A handy 67-run stand for India  comes to an end.
On the middle stump, Kohli flicks it through mid-wicket for a run.
Makes room and then guides it down to third man for a run.
Slower one and on the pads, Jadeja works it with soft hands through mid-wicket. They taken one, go for the second and make it in.
Slower ball and on middle, Kohli guides it towards point for a run.
Pat Cummins is back on.
Gives it a lot of air and bowls it around leg, it is the googly. Jadeja looks to sweep but misses to get hit on the pads. Two dots to end an excellent over by Zampa. Could have easily had a wicket.
The leg spinner but on the pads, Jadeja works it to mid-wicket.
On the off stump, Kohli taps it towards cover for a run.
The googly on the pads, it is worked around the corner for a run.

DROPPED! That should have been taken! A little short and on middle, Jadeja goes back and pulls it. It is not off the middle and it is to the right of Stoinis at deep mid-wicket. He runs to his right and gets two hands to it but fails to hang on. The batsmen take two. How costly will this prove? Had he taken this, Australia would have been into the bowlers then.
Flatter and on the pads, it is flicked through mid-wicket for a run.
Adam Zampa is back now.
A dot to end! So only 7 despite it going for a boundary early. On a length and around off, kept out.
Pulled right off the middle but finds the man at deep square leg for a run.
Plays it with an angled bat towards third man. The batsmen take a run.
Played to the point region by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
The bumper on off, Kohli looks to drag his pull but ends up getting a bottom edge back to the bowler.

FOUR! Gets to his ton in style! Century no. 40. Magnificent ton this is from the Indian skipper. An innings of a lot of character and determination. A ton on wicket which has played a lot of tricks. Leading from the front is the skipper. He gets there with a cut shot. It races to the point fence. Takes his helmet off and soaks in the applause. He knows he needs to be there till the end. Also, now that he has got to his milestone, you might just see him up the ante.
Onto 99! He keeps strike for the next over also as he flicks it through square leg. 50-run stand is also up. Another vital stand.
Nicely nudges it towards mid-wicket for a run.
On the shorter side, Kohli hits it through mid-wicket and moves onto 98.
On the pads, Jadeja looks to flick but misses. It rolls towards short fine leg. A leg bye taken.
Flatter and quicker outside off, Jadeja looks to cut but misses. Maxwell gets excited but no one else is.
Around off, Kohli waits and then opens the face. It goes towards short third man for a quick run.

Just a boundary away now! Full and around off, Kohli leans into it and strokes it through covers. Handscomb runs to his right, dives just before the ball crosses the ropes and pulls it back in. Saves a run for his side.
Goes short, Jadeja pulls it nicely through square leg. There is a fielder in the deep so just a run.
On the hips of the batsman, it is worked around the corner for a single. Happy with singles at the moment are the Indians.
The batsman opens the face of the bat and helps it to third man. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Goes wide of the crease and bowls it on middle, Jadeja blocks it out.
Slightly short, Kohli goes back early and pulls it through mid-wicket for a run. Just 8 runs away from a ton now.
Nathan Coulter-Nile is back on.
Another single to end the over as this is worked through mid-wicket.
On off, Jadeja makes room and then opens the face. It goes towards short third man and they take a run.
Whips it hard but straight to the man at deep mid-wicket. Only a run.
Flatter and outside off, Kohli plays it late but finds short third man.
Flatter and shorter on off, Jadeja slaps it down to long off for a run. 2000 ODI runs for Jadeja. JUST THE THIRD INDIAN to achieve the double of 2000 ODI runs and 150 ODI wickets.
Tosses it up on middle, Kohli flicks it through mid-wicket and a run is taken.
POWERPLAY 3 time. 5 fielders allowed outside the 30-yard circle till the end.
A dot to end! Shorter in length and on off, Jadeja stands tall and defends it onto the ground.
Another single as this is guided down to third man.
On the off pole, Kohli defends it to point.
On the shorter side and outside off, Jadeja guides it down to third man for a run.

Direct hit needed... but missed! Kohli was way short there. Length ball and around off, VK taps it towards point and wants a run. He is off, but Jadeja is not interested. Kohli though is a long way down. He tries and turns to get in but that does not seem possible. To his luck though, Maxwell misses his shy at the striker's end. The fielder backing up is too deep and an overthrow is taken. Lucky reprieve there and Australia will feel, this is the chance they needed to take. This could be the difference between a 240 and a 280...
Angles it into the pads, Kohli works it towards mid-wicket.
Well bowled and well played in the end! This is flatter and on off, this one pitches, stays low and skids through. Jadeja just about gets his bat down in time and keeps it out.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. One run added to the total.
Jadeja now hits this one down to long on and gets to the other end. 200 up for the hosts. 11 more overs to go after this one. However, only 4 wickets left is the problem.
Floats it up on off, Kohli eases it down to long on and takes another run. Moves onto 85.
On the shorter side, Jadeja goes back and guides it through point for a run.
Fuller on the pads, Kohli works it down to deep mid-wicket and gets to the other end.
Outside off, pushed straight to point. Not a bad over from Cummins - 5 from the first 3, just one from the next 3.
Full and straight, watchfully defended.
Outside off, this time Virat quietly nudges it towards third man for a run.
FOUR! Not often do you see Kohli throwing his bat! This is one of those rare occasions. Short and outside off, the Indian skipper latches onto the width and gets it behind point for a boundary!

This one nips back in, Jadeja looks to defend but the ball takes the inside edge and hits him on the pads, rolling down to the leg side. The batsmen scamper a single as Cummins and Carey appeal for LBW. Umpire Dharmasena informs Cummins that there was bat involved.
On a good length around middle, watchfully defended.
Pat Cummins is back on now.

Shot! Excellent wrist work! Kohli whips it of the off stump. It is in the gap in the mid-wicket region. Handscomb there runs to his left, slides and collects the ball. He then tries to parry it to the Coulter-Nile who runs to his right from long on. His throw is a touch wide and the two runs become easy for the batsmen.
Down the leg side, the umpire stretches his hands sideways.
Angles it on the off pole, Kohli goes back and works it to square leg.
Floats it up outside off, Jadeja strokes it through covers and takes a single.
Outside off, left alone.
Hits it more straighter this time than the last ball and a single is taken.
Finds the man at square leg with a flick shot.
Down the leg side, Kohli looks to hit it fine but misses. It has been wided.
A couple to end as Jadeja plays a check-drive towards wide long off. He calls for two straightaway and the batters take it.
Gives it a nice loop and lands it on off, Jadeja defends it off the front foot.
Works it with the angle towards square leg but for on runs.
On the stumps, blocked.
On the shorter side, Kohli hits it through covers and takes a run.
Tosses it up on middle, Kohli works it towards mid-wicket.
Uses his feet and strokes it to long on and keeps strike for the next over.
Works it with the turn towards mid-wicket.
Kohli makes a little room and tries to hit it through covers. Finch there though dives and gets a hand to it. Deflects it towards wide long off and only a couple.
Looks to give it a little more air but ends up bowling a low full. It is hit down to long on for a run.
Flighted ball on off, Jadeja strokes it to covers.
Eases it down to long on for a run.
Glenn Maxwell is back.
Around middle and leg, worked through fine leg for one.
Short and outside off, cut through point for a run.

SAFE! Just by an inch! Beautiful bowling from Lyon in the first place. Tossed up outside off, Jadeja came forward to defend but then the ball spun away and bounced. Jaddu missed while lunging and in that process, his back foot was lifted in the air. Alex Carey did collect but to the naked eye it seemed like he took just that extra second to take the bails off. Replays show that the back foot landed on the line, then skid back in by just a fraction. Yes. JUST a fraction, before Carey could try and make a stumping.
STUMPING APPEAL! Not much celebrations from the Aussies. Did Jadeja get his back foot back in time? Referred upstairs...
Full and around off, watchfully defended.
Goes back and plays it with the turn towards short fine leg for a single.

Full and around off, writes through square leg for a comfortable couple. Both these batsmen are quick between the wickets. Replays show that Kohli took the second run by running right in the middle of the pitch. Right in the middle.
Outside off, left alone. 4 runs and two wickets from the over. Is this the over which changes the momentum in Australia's favor?

Just short! Zampa has started to find the right line and length here. Bowls the googly around off, it pitches and turns. Jadeja lunges and tries to defend but the ball takes the outside edge and falls just short of first slip. The key there was he played that with soft hands.
NO hat-trick as it is safely negotiated. Flatter and on middle, Jadeja goes back and works it to short fine leg.
Ravindra Jadeja walks in at number 8, replacing Dhoni, to face the hat-trick ball.

OUT! Two-in-two for Zampa and the two batsmen who steered India home in the last game, are dismissed. Excellent captaincy as Finch brought in the slip fielder for the new batsman but you can also question the shot here. Zampa bowls it flatter and outside off, it pitches and turns away a little. Dhoni looks to guide it towards third man but there is not a lot of width on offer. The ball takes the outside edge and flies towards Khawaja at first slip. He too takes a sharp catch to his right. Australia now into the bowling all-rounders. Zampa is on a hat-trick.
MS Dhoni comes out now, at number 7, to a deafening roar.

OUT! Zampa strikes! Australia have two in quick succession and India now have half their side back in the hut. The hero of the last game, fails to make an impact here. Adam floats it up outside off, once again it is very full. That though plays in the advantage of the bowler as the batsman looks to go over covers. He fails to get underneath the ball and hence, does not get the desired elevation. Ends up hitting it flat and hard towards cover where Finch takes a sharp catch. Australia crawling their way back into the game and a much-needed wicket for Zampa as this should give him confidence now.
FOUR! Inside edge and a boundary! This is outside off, Jadhav looks to sweep but it takes the inside edge, goes between the legs of the keeper and into the third man fence.
A dot to end! Just a run from this one as Kohli defends it off the back foot.
This is bowled at 97 kph and it is outside off. Kohli looks to guide it past short third man who is finer and hence it is straight to him.
The straighter one on middle, Jadhav plays inside the line, it goes off the outside edge towards point for a run.
Once again plays it with the turn but to the man at mid-wicket.
Flicks it with the turn but finds the man at square leg.
On the off pole, the batter defends it out.
A short ball to finish! Kohli goes back and punches it through covers for a couple.
This is worked around the corner through square leg for a run.
On the shorter side, Kohli punches it down to long on and takes a run.
Too full again, Kohli once again smashes it back towards the bowler. He fumbles but no extra run conceded.
Tosses it up on off, Jadhav pushes it down to long off for a run.
Flatter and on off, KJ defends it.
Short again, this is pulled straight to square leg.
Around off, short in length, Kohli looks to cut but the ball stays low and takes the under edge towards point.

Excellent fielding effort from Peter Handscomb. Short and outside off, Kedar cuts it behind point. The ball rolls away to the fence but Handscomb races to his left and dives full stretch, landing awkwardly on his left shoulder. He manages to save the boundary but clutches his left shoulder in pain. Hope he is okay. Three runs taken.
Landed outside off, spinning in, watchfully defended.
Action replay of the previous delivery, sans the striker.
Around middle, Jadhav works it through square leg for a single.
On off, kept out. End of an action-packed over, 9 runs but more importantly a wicket from it.
Kedar Jadhav comes in at number 6, replacing Shankar.

OUT! Yes, the ball has flicked the fingertips and Shankar is short of his crease. He walks back in disappointment and disgust. He was playing so well out there, so fluent and his innings ends in a very unfortunate manner. Australia though will be relieved as this partnership was taking the game away from them. Zampa tosses this up, once again it is very full. Kohli smashes it towards the bowler who sticks his hand out to the right. The ball then goes onto hit the stumps. Shankar in the meantime looks to get back in with a dive. The Australians appeal and it is a very confident one. The umpire takes it upstairs and after the replays, OUT flashes on the giant screen. The 81-run stand has been ended but it has provided the much-needed impetus to the Indian innings. However, Australia will now look to pull things back a little.

Is that the end of Shankar's innings? It would be a very unfortunate way if it is. The umpire has gone upstairs to check. First, whether the bowler has touched the ball, second, if Shankar has made it in.
FOUR! Too full and it has been put away! Gives it a little more air but lands it very full. Kohli leans into it and strokes it through covers. It is away from the sweeper and a boundary.
Shortish and outside off, Kohli guides it to point.
Hits it well again, uppishly but well short of the man at long off. A run.
FOUR! Straight as an arrow! He is playing a gem here. This is tossed up on middle, Shankar lunges forward and then hits it over the bowler's head for a boundary.
Adam Zampa is back on now.
Kohli looks to find the same gap but instead finds the man at square leg.
This time finds the gap through the square leg region and takes one.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads.
This one stays low! Flatter and outside off, Shankar gets his bat down in time and pushes it back to the bowler.
Now eases this down to long on and takes a run.
FOUR! 18 from the last 7 balls! Flatter and just a little outside the off pole. Kohli waits for it and then uses the pace, guides it past short third man and into the fence.

SIX! A biggie to end the over! 14 from it! An expensive first by Stoinis! Another short delivery, too easy at his pace. Shankar stands tall and pulls it over the mid-wicket fence. He is into the 40s now.

Carey does well there! This is on the pads, Shankar looks to flick but it brushes his pads and goes to the left of the keeper. He dives and gets a hand to it. Takes the pace off the ball, the fielder from fine leg does the mopping up job and two have been taken. Leg byes signaled!
FOUR! What a shot! Best shot so far played by Shankar! Slightly short and on middle, Shankar goes back quickly and then lifts it over mid-wicket. No one in the deep so a boundary.
Waits for it and then runs it down to third man for a run.
Kohli uses his feet but Stoinis bowls it short. VK still goes for the pull but mistimes it to mid-wicket.
On the shorter side, Shankar pulls it through square leg for a single.
Marcus Stoinis is on now.
Pushes it through. Shankar works it uppishly but well wide of the fielder at short mid-wicket. It goes down to long on for a run.
On the middle pole, Shankar works it with the turn to mid-wicket.
Tosses it up on off, blocked.
The batsman works it down the leg side. They pick up a single.

50-run stand up and it has come in very good time! India were in a spot of bother when the two joined forces but they are taking them to safer shores. Shankar works this through mid-wicket and gets to the other end.
Tosses it up outside off, Shankar keeps it out.

Good stop and well fielded! A little too straight. Shankar works it towards wide mid on. Lyon there runs to his right, times his dive and keeps it down to a run. 9 from the over and the partnership is 49 now.
Played to the point region by the batsman. One run added to the total.
LEG BYE! Down the leg side. Shankar looks to flick but misses. It hits his pads and rolls towards fine leg for a run.

Fifty for Virat Kohli. His 50th fifty in ODIs! A captain's knock this. Came in early and now is looking solid out there. Has made batting look so easy on a wicket where batting is not easy. Only half the job done though. He pushes this through covers and takes a run.
Plays this one late and guides it down to third man for an easy run. Shankar is really playing well out there.
FOUR! On the up! Length delivery, Shankar uses his wrists and then strokes it past mid on. A boundary.
Tosses it up outside off, Shankar keeps it out.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Moves onto 49 as he pushes it down to long on for a run.
Now plays it with the turn and works it through mid-wicket for a run.
FOUR! Tickled fine and a boundary! On the pads, Shankar flicks it very fine on the leg side and it races away to the fence.
On the pads, it is worked towards short fine leg for a run.
On the fuller side, Shankar drives it back to the bowler. Back-to-back good overs for Australia here.
A little too straight, it is worked around the corner for a run.
Back of a length on off, Kohli chops it to point.
Length delivery again, Shankar strokes it on the up towards cover. The fielder there makes a good diving stop but can't stop the run.
On the fuller side on off, Shankar strokes it to mid off.
Good length on off, Kohli guides it down to third man and gets to the other end.
Well done! Just a single from the over! Shankar works it to the right of the bowler. Lyon dives and saves a run.
Plays it late with the angle towards point.
On the middle pole, Shankar lunges and blocks it out.
Tosses it up on off, Kohli whips it down to long on for a run.
The straighter one on off, goes on with the angle. Kohli plays inside the line and gets beaten.
Flatter and on middle, Kohli goes back and works it to mid-wicket.
Change of ends for Nathan Lyon.
On the stumps again, Vijay Shankar works it to mid-wicket. Good comeback by the bowler, ends the over with three dots.
On a length and around off, kept out. The last two deliveries is what NCN has to bowl on consistent basis.
Good delivery! Goes wide of the crease and angles it into the batsman. The batter looks to defend but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Gets his line wrong again! It is on the pads, Kohli flicks it towards fine leg for a run. Coulter-Nile gets away with that one.
Good running and good batting! Got the boundary on the last ball and now takes a single! Back of a length on off, VS taps it with soft hands on the off side.

FOUR! Was not so good in his first spell and he starts off with a poor ball here. Short and outside off, Shankar goes back and guides it through point. Welcomes back NCN into the attack with a boundary. 100 up for India.
Nathan Coulter-Nile is back on now.
The googly, Shankar picks it and plays it with the turn through mid-wicket for a run.

BYE! Well bowled! Tossed up outside off, this one pitches, stays low and skids through. Kohli looks to defend but the ball goes past the bat before it comes down. The keeper too fails to go down in time. It brushes his pads and rolls towards third man for a run.
Third full toss in the over. Shankar though does not take toll of this one. It is hit down to long off for a run.
Tosses this one up nicely! Kohli drives it through covers and gets to the other end.
Another full toss, Shankar strokes it down to long on and gets to the other end.
Zampa has not been at his best here! Not hitting a consistent length. Serves a full toss now on middle, Shankar hits it towards wide long on for a couple.
5 singles in this over as Shankar waits for it and then nudges it square on the leg side for a run.
4th single of the over as this is flicked through mid-wicket.
Shankar now eases it down to long on and another single results.
Floats it up on middle, VK flicks it through mid-wicket and gets to the other end.
On the off pole, Kohli blocks it out.
Shankar works it with the turn towards mid-wicket and takes a single.

FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries and this is way better than the last one! Overcompensates does Zampa as he lands it very full outside off. Kohli creams it through covers to end the over with a boundary. Another expensive one from Zampa as 10 come from it.
FOUR! Poor ball and put away! Short and on middle, very short actually. Kohli goes back and pulls it through square leg for a boundary.
Pull his length back and lands it on middle, Kohli keeps it out.
Well done! Full and on middle, Kohli hits it to the right of the bowler. He gets two hands to it but can't stop it cleanly. Saves a single though.
Shankar is off the mark as he eases it down to long on for a single.
Flighted ball on off, Kohli strokes it through covers for a run.
Drinks! Vijay Shankar is the new man in.

OUT! No bat there, it has pitched in line and it is crashing into the middle stump. A waste of a review to be honest by Rayudu as that looked out to the naked eye. He has to walk back and he takes India's only review along with him. Another bidding partnership comes to an end and Lyon makes an impact straightaway. Strikes off his last ball of his first over. Nothing great about the delivery though. It pitches around the leg pole and goes on with the angle. Rayudu plays all around it. He misses and the ball hits him above the knee role on the back pad. An appeal follows and the umpire raises his finger. Ambati looks at his skipper at the other end and then signals the 'T'. Replays show that the on-field call is the right one. India in a spot of bother here.
India review now! Rayudu is given out LBW. He has reviewed. Is there an inside edge or has that pitched outside the leg stump?
The quicker one but this is quite short. Kohli goes back and punches it down to long on for a run.
Once again plays it late but this time finds the man at short third man.
FOUR! DEFT! Lovely shot this! Lyon tosses it up outside off, Kohli waits for it, sees the ball closely and then guides it through short third man. Runs starting to come thick and fast now.
Tossed up outside off, Kohli works it with the turn to mid-wicket.
Leg byes! A little too straight. Kohli looks to pull but the ball hits his pads and goes through short fine leg. Two taken.
Nathan Lyon is on now.
An excellent cover drive but just for a run as there is a sweeper in place. Another good over for the Indians. They slowly getting a move on now. 14 from the last two.
Direct hit but the batsman is well in! Kohli plays it late towards short third man. He thinks of a run but is rightly sent back by his partner.
Down the leg side, Rayudu looks to flick but misses. It brushes his pads and rolls towards short fine leg. A leg bye taken.
FOUR! Help yourself says Zampa. Bowls a full toss. Rayudu goes back and pulls it over mid-wicket. No fielder in the deep and a boundary results.
Another tossed up ball, Rayudu ends up playing outside the line, the gets it off the inner half to the right of the bowler who saves a run with a dive to his right.
Tosses this one up on off, Kohli drives it down to long off for a single.
On the shorter side, Kohli goes back and pulls it all along the ground to deep square leg for a single.
On the shorter side, it is whipped through mid-wicket for a single.
Played through mid-wicket by the batsman.
Leading edge! Looks to flick it against the angle but closes the face of the bat a little early. Gets a soft leading edge to covers.
FOUR! A much-needed boundary here! Maxwell is guilty of bowling it a little too full here. Rayudu plants his front foot ahead and across and then strokes it through covers for a boundary.
On the middle pole, Kohli goes back and pushes it down to long on for a run.
Slightly on the shorter side, Kohli goes back and punches it down to long on for a run. Just a couple from this over. Australia continue keeping it tight.
This is driven through covers for an easy run.
Flighted ball on off, Rayudu lunges and blocks it out.
Another slider, Rayudu this time goes back and pushes it to the off side.
OHHH! The slider on off, Rayudu goes back and looks to pull. The ball though hurries onto him, it takes the inside edge and hits the pads of the batsman.
Flatter and on middle, the batter goes back and blocks it.
Adam Zampa is on now.
Lunges forward this time and flicks it through mid-wicket and retains strike for the next over.
Good shot! Fires it outside off, Rayudu strokes it through covers. Wide of long off for a couple. 50 up for India.
Flighted ball and this is eased down to long on for a run.
Continues bowling the straighter line, Kohli flicks it to square leg.
Uses his feet but Maxwell bowls it short. Kohli works it to the right of the bowler.
On middle, Rayudu works it through mid-wicket and takes a single.

On the shorter side, Kohli shuffles right across and works it through square leg. He takes one and calls for the second and the batters complete it with ease. Big boundaries here, there should be a lot of 2s available.
Nicely guided! Waits for the ball to come to him and then opens the face, it goes towards third man for a run.
Goes wide of the crease and angles it into the the off stump, Rayudu hits it back to the bowler.
WIDE! Way too short and this one bounces well over the batsman's head. Wided.
Just a little bit of width on offer outside off, Rayudu strokes it nicely off the back foot but finds the man at point.
Continues bowling it on a length and on off, Rayudu opens the face of the bat but can't beat the fielder at gully.
Length delivery, Rayudu drives it firmly towards mid off. He wants a run but the fielder there gets to the ball quickly and hence, Kohli asks his to go back.
A little bit short on off, Rayudu goes back and punches it down to long on for a run.
Worked against the angle through mid-wicket for an easy run.
A straighter line again, Rayudu flicks it towards square leg. The fielder there dives to his right and makes a half-stop. Can't stop the run though.
Fires it on middle again, Kohli works it through mid-wicket and takes a run.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
On the pads, it is worked to mid-wicket.
Powerplay 2 has been signaled! Now a maximum of four fielders can be placed outside the circle till the 40th over.

Oops.... that is a hoick. Rayudu comes down the track and has a wild swing but is nowhere near the pitch of the ball. Gets a thick inside edge onto his pads which rolls away to the off side. That is a very, very rash shot. Kohli will not be happy seeing that. Cummins has a word with Rayudu, followed by a smile. A maiden for Cummins, 10/1 in the last 4 overs!
This one comes in, but stays low as well. Ambati stays back to defend but gets a thick inside edge onto his pads.
On a good length outside off, Rayudu plays inside the line, expecting it to come in with the angle but then the ball seams away to beat the outside edge.
Full and straight, Rayudu stays back and blocks.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot.
Full and outside off, pushed straight to cover.
Pat Cummins is back on. 3-1-9-1 so far.
AR is off the mark as he pushes it towards mid off and scampers across for a single. End of a successful over by Maxwell.
One again it is flatter and outside off, Rayudu for the second time in a row, plays it to point.
Flatter and outside off, Rayudu guides it to point.
Ambati Rayudu walks in at number 4, replacing Dhawan.

OUT! Three reds and Dhawan has to take the long walk back! What a review by Australia and Maxwell has struck gold here. He is absolutely elated. The offie has cut short the partnership which was looking very good and also brought the downfall of Dhawan who was timing the ball really well. Maxwell does what he has been doing till now. Fires it in on middle, Dhawan goes back to whip, he though misses and is hit on the front pad. An appeal follows, a loud one from the bowler but the umpire shakes his head. Maxwell convinces his skipper to go for the review and Finch does so. Replays roll in and they show no inside edge. Hawk Eye shows the on-field call has to be overturned. Both the openers back in the hut within Powerplay 1 here.
Review time! A huge shout for an LBW has not been given. Maxwell is pretty confident and he wants it to be reviewed. Finch does so, Dhawan is the man in question. Looks close though.
This one is angled into the batsman, Dhawan goes back and very late guides it to point.
A little too full on off, Dhawan drives it really nicely but to the man at covers.
The googly to end! Dhawan works it towards fine leg and takes a single. 6 from Zampa's first and India going along well after the early wicket.
A little too full this time, Dhawan works it across the angle towards mid-wicket. Maxwell there dives to his right and makes a very good stop.
The googly but it is a little too straight, VK works it through mid-wicket and jogs to the other end.
Flatter and on middle, Kohli goes back and pushes it towards mid on and gets to the other end.
A half-tracker on the first ball and a full toss on the second. Kohli strokes it down to long off for a run.
Starts off with a shorter delivery on middle, Kohli goes back and pulls it through mid-wicket for a couple.
Adam Zampa is on now. Spin from both ends.
On the pads, SD looks to flick but misses. A muted appeal but nothing from the umpire. Going down leg. A good first over by Maxwell.
Another one which drifts in from outside off. Dhawan blocks it.

An appeal but nothing. Flatter and this one drifts in from outside off. Dhawan plays it really late. Maxwell appeals as he feels it is pad first but the umpire shakes his head. Right call from the umpire and replays confirm that.
On the middle pole, Kohli goes back and works it towards square leg. Kohli wants a run but Dhawan waits. He then sees the ball go past the diving fielder there and goes for the run.
This is angled into the stump, Dhawan goes back and pushes it towards cover for a run.
Starts off with a delivery down the leg side, Kohli works it towards short fine leg for a run.
Glenn Maxwell is on now.
Two good deliveries to end! Length again and on off, Dhawan blocks it out.
The batsman has pushed it to the cover region.
FOUR! Poor bowling this is! Down the leg side, Dhawan says thank you very much. He helps it on its way to the fine leg fence.
Edgy run! A little more wider outside off, Kohli looks to stroke it on the up, the ball goes off the outer half, all along the ground to third man for a single.
Good length and on off again, Kohli strokes it on the up to the man at covers.
Goes wide of the crease and lands it on off, Kohli guides it to point.
Length and outside off, left alone. 8 from this over as well, 16 from the last two.

FOUR! Dhawan is looking in great touch here! Just a little bit of width on offer outside off and that was enough for the opener. He goes back and then guides it through point, it races away to the fence.
Full and outside off, Dhawan looks to drive but his bat turns in his hands. Mistimes the ball to covers.
FOUR! Hammered away! Short and on middle, Dhawan is quickly onto the back foot and he pulls it hard through mid-wicket for a boundary. Raining boundaries here.
Just ahead of a length this time, Dhawan plays a nice drive but straight to cover.
Length delivery and on middle, Dhawan keeps it out.
Works it with the angle to the man at mid on. A dot to end another expensive over by Coulter-Nile. Not a good start for him.
Better from Nathan Coulter-Nile! Drags his length back and bowls it on off. Kohli defends it confidently.
FOUR! A little too straight and NCN pays the price. Full and on middle, Kohli this time uses his wrists and works it through mid-wicket. No stopping those. Second boundary in the over.
This time he drives it to mid off, can't find the gap though.

FOUR! The on-drive, probably the hardest shot in the game and it is played to perfection here. Full and on off, Kohli shuffles across and then with a straight bat strokes it to mid on. A boundary, his first.
On the fuller side and outside off, an area where Kohli is a touch vulnerable. Virat though takes his foot right to the pitch of the ball and strokes it to mid off.
That was quick! Back of a length and shoots off the surface. Dhawan is on his toes as he guides it to point. Another excellent over by Cummins comes to an end.
Short and on the body, Dhawan defends it onto the ground by taking a hand off the handle.
On the fuller side again, Dhawan guides it to point.
On the fuller side again and this one comes back into the left-hander. Dhawan hits it uppishly but well short of the bowler.

Uppish but away from the fielder at gully. Full and outside off, a little shape away. Kohli looks to drive but he gets an outside edge through backward point and down towards third man for a run. The skipper is off the mark.
Way too wide outside off, Kohli will not be going after it so early in his innings.

A couple to end an expensive first by NCN! Slightly straighter again, Dhawan works it through mid on and takes a brace. 7 from Nathan's first. Not what Australia wanted, they would have liked Coulter-Nile to bowl a good follow-up over after Cummins bowled an excellent first.
Closer to the off pole this time and the length is similar. Dhawan guides it to point.
Length again but the line is outside off, left alone.
Coulter-Nile finally gets his line right as he lands it on a length and around off. Dhawan blocks it.
Another crisp drive but straight to the cover fielder. Good shots to begin with by Dhawan.

FOUR! Dhawan off the mark in style! First boundary of the game is off his bat. Easy pickings for him. It is full and on the pads, Dhawan flicks it. It is right off the middle and it races to the fence. This is should give him confidence after he was dismissed for not a lot in the last game.
The inswinger but down the leg side. It has been wided. First run for India courtesy an extra.
Virat Kohli, the Indian skipper, walks out to the middle. Aslo, Nathan Coulter-Nile to bowl from the other end with the second new ball.

OUT! In the air... taken! Cummins' excellent first over ends with a wicket. However, this was probably the worst ball he bowled in this over. He won't care though as Australia strike early. This one is short and wide outside off, Rohit senses an opportunity to get off the mark, so he goes for the cut shot. There is extra bounce though on that one and hence, Rohit can't get on top of it. He gets a top edge which flies down to third man. Zampa there takes a few steps in and accepts it. Sharma walks back without troubling the scorers and it is the ideal start for Australia. A wicket maiden by Cummins.
On a length again, no swing on the two deliveries which were not bowled full. Rohit easily keeps it out.
Drags his length back this time and attacks the off pole. Rohit defends it on the leg side.

BEAUTY! More movement for Cummins this time. Third full ball in a row. It is outside off and goes away further. Rohit goes after it but gets beaten. Not moving his feet here is Rohit. Understandable though as it is early in his innings. However, that maybe the reason why Cummins is bowling so full.
Full again, some swing again. Rohit once again does not put in a  long enough stride but still guides it towards point. Maxwell there makes a good stop diving to his right.
Goes very full and on the stumps, a hint of outswing for the bowler there. Rohit Sharma with a straight bat but minimal foot movement, strokes it to mid off. Starts off right on the money does Pat.

We are all set for the action to begin. Out come the players and the umpires. Rohit Sharma and Shikhar Dhawan are the openers for India. The right-hander will be on strike and he will be facing Pat Cummins who has the first new ball in hand. A slip and a gully in place for him. Here we go...

Indian skipper, Virat Kohli, says they wanted to bat first. Mentions it looks dry and there is not going to be a lot of dew in the second innings. Reckons the pitch seems like it would just get worse. He expects the wicket to be low and slow and they will have to adapt to it quickly. Ends by saying their middle order came to the fore in the previous game which is a very good thing.

Australian skipper, Aaron Finch, expects it to spin early on but then become easy to bat when the lights come on. Mentions they did not have a good game in the last one but still managed to get close. A better effort with the ball and the bat here might just see them end on the right side. Informs that Lyon and Marsh come in place of Turner and Behrendorff.
TOSS - Up goes the coin and it once again lands in the favor of Australia. To the surprise of everyone, THEY ARE BOWLING FIRST.

PITCH REPORT - Murali Kartik and Sunil Gavaskar are doing the pitch report. The former asks the latter what he reckons about the pitch. Sunil Gavaskar says it is a pitch made for the spinners. Mentions there are quite a lot of cracks on it and the team batting second will have a harder time as the pitch will probably get more difficult. Informs the boundaries here are long and batters are not going to have a good time. Reckons the captain winning the toss should probably bat first.

Hello and welcome to the second ODI between India and Australia. Change in format bought change in fortunes for the hosts. They are 1-0 up in the series and will look to make it two-in-two and make it difficult for the visitors to come back in the series. Australia, meanwhile, will want to get back to winning ways and level the series. Let us hope we are in for an exciting clash. Stay tuned for further updates...
